name: The World with No Memory
source:
The game takes place in the future, in the 22nd century. In this game, you will control the actions of a young married couple. The husband is a simple guy, a student from Earth, the wife is a cool and sexy ex-adventurer. What challenges await them on a mysterious planet?

[From [url=https://fluffylynx.itch.io/the-world-with-no-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在未来，22世纪。在这个游戏中，你将控制一对年轻夫妇的行动。丈夫是一个简单的人，来自地球的学生，妻子是一个酷而性感的前冒险家。在一个神秘的星球上，有什么挑战等待着他们呢？

[来自[url=https://fluffylynx.itch.io/the-world-with-no-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
